relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: we demonstrated that capsaicin-induced vasodilation is mediated via CB1 receptors and the putative CBe receptors, without direct involvement of TRPV1 channels or CB2 receptors

relationships.subject: anandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: our findings show that AEA-induced vasorelaxation is mediated by TRPV1 as these responses were inhibited in the presence of capsazepine

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: supporting the hypothesis that TRPV1 channels modulate CB1 receptor activity

key_findings: Capsaicin-induced vasorelaxation of human coronary arteries is mediated by CB1 and putative endothelial CB receptors, not TRPV1 or CB2.
TRPV1 desensitisation inhibits AEA/ACEA vasorelaxation only in female arteries, indicating sex-dependent TRPV1-CB1 crosstalk.
